name: Ondas

eyebrow.en: Ondas Inc. · Common stock · West Palm Beach, Florida
eyebrow.zh: Ondas · 普通股 · 佛罗里达州西棕榈滩

title.en: Drones, drone-killers and robots, assembled by acquisition.
title.zh: 无人机、反无人机与机器人，靠收购拼装而成。

lede.en: Ondas has turned from a small rail-radio company into a defense-drone group, buying a string of businesses in Israel, the US and Europe. Revenue went from $6M to $84M in a year, and it targets $525–550M for 2026. Losses are still large, deals are partly paid in stock, and the shares are down about 40% this year.
lede.zh: Ondas 已从一家小型铁路无线电公司，转型为国防无人机集团，在以色列、美国与欧洲连续收购。营收一年内从 600 万美元增至 8400 万，2026 年目标 5.25–5.5 亿。亏损仍大，收购部分以股票支付，股价今年下跌约 40%。

s.zh: 按 FY26 营收目标 5.25–5.5 亿 · 仍亏损

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Ondas peaked at $14 in January and has trended lower since, even as orders and acquisitions piled up.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。Ondas 1月见顶 14 美元，此后一路走低，尽管订单与收购不断增加。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Most of the growth since late 2025 comes from acquisitions, so year-on-year rates overstate organic growth (85% on a same-portfolio basis in Q2). The last bar is company guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。2025 年底以来的增长大多来自收购，因此同比增速高估了内生增长（Q2 同口径增长 85%）。最后一根柱为公司指引中值。

s.zh: 备考订单储备约 7.57 亿

p.en: Ondas has booked more than $270M of orders since June, including a $56M European order for munition safety devices on Oct 5 and US orders for its ULTRA and IonStrike drones.
p.zh: 6月以来 Ondas 已获逾 2.7 亿美元订单，包括10月5日一笔 5600 万美元欧洲弹药安全装置订单，以及 ULTRA 与 IonStrike 无人机的美国订单。

p.en: About $1.4B of cash and investments at the end of June gives room to fund losses and more acquisitions without new debt.
p.zh: 6月底约 14 亿美元现金及投资，可在不举债的情况下支撑亏损与更多收购。

p.en: The guide needs about $390M in H2, almost triple H1. Q3 is guided to $140–155M; shipping on time is the main test.
p.zh: 指引意味下半年需约 3.9 亿美元，接近上半年三倍。Q3 指引 1.4–1.55 亿；按时交付是主要考验。

p.en: Ondas pays for many deals partly in shares, including $100M of stock for GATE and Bron in September, and the share count has risen sharply.
p.zh: Ondas 多项收购部分以股票支付，包括9月为 GATE 与 Bron 支付的 1 亿美元股票，股数大幅增加。

p.en: Q2 operating loss was $163M including $106M of non-cash charges. Company-wide adjusted EBITDA profit is not targeted until Q4 2027.
p.zh: Q2 营业亏损 1.63 亿美元，其中 1.06 亿为非现金费用。公司整体调整后 EBITDA 盈利目标要到 2027 年 Q4。

p.en: Ondas now runs many acquired businesses across several countries. Keeping them on track while scaling production is hard for a young group.
p.zh: Ondas 现管理多国的众多收购业务。在扩大生产的同时整合好它们，对年轻集团是一大挑战。

p.en: Guide: $140–155M revenue. Analysts expect a loss of about $0.06 a share.
p.zh: 指引：营收 1.4–1.55 亿美元。分析师预计每股亏损约 $0.06。

p.en: Management targets positive adjusted EBITDA at its operating platform by Q4 2026.
p.zh: 管理层目标 2026 年 Q4 运营平台调整后 EBITDA 转正。

p.en: Target for positive adjusted EBITDA across the whole company.
p.zh: 公司整体调整后 EBITDA 转正的目标时点。

sources: Price, market cap and beta: Yahoo Finance, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Ondas Inc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Ondas Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 12 quarters from Q3 2023 to Q2 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2023 年第三季至 2026 年第二季共 12 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Ondas burned a steady $6–11M a quarter while it was small. Since late 2025 the burn has grown with the business, to $94M in Q2 2026, as acquired companies, working capital for big orders and public-company costs piled up. Its cash comes from repeated share sales and warrant exercises, not from operations.
read.zh: Ondas 规模小时每季稳定烧掉 600–1100 万美元。2025 年底以来，随收购企业、大额订单所需营运资金及上市公司成本增加，烧钱规模随之扩大，2026 年 Q2 达 9400 万美元。现金来自多次增发与认股权证行权，而非经营。

read.en: My estimate assumes losses narrow as guided, with the operating platform near break-even by Q4 2026, giving about −$200M of free cash flow over four quarters. That is well covered by the $1.4B cash pile, but about $160M was also spent on acquisitions in September.
read.zh: 我的估计假设亏损如指引收窄、运营平台在 2026 年 Q4 接近收支平衡，四季自由现金流约 −2 亿美元。14 亿美元现金足以覆盖，但9月另有约 1.6 亿美元用于收购。

p.en: $105M cash for GATE and Bron plus $56M for three defense businesses in September, with earn-outs on top.
p.zh: 9月以 1.05 亿美元现金收购 GATE 与 Bron，另以 5600 万收购三家国防企业，另有业绩对赌付款。

p.en: Adjusted EBITDA loss was $50.6M in Q2 and is guided to shrink.
p.zh: Q2 调整后 EBITDA 亏损 5060 万美元，指引将收窄。

p.en: Building inventory for large drone and munition orders ties up cash.
p.zh: 为大额无人机与弹药订单备货占用现金。

p.en: Equity raises lifted cash from $68M a year ago to about $1.4B.
p.zh: 股权融资令现金从一年前 6800 万升至约 14 亿美元。

p.en: Over $270M of orders since June should turn into revenue and cash in coming quarters.
p.zh: 6月以来逾 2.7 亿美元订单将在未来几季转化为营收与现金。

p.en: Adjusted gross margin of about 50% helps as volumes grow.
p.zh: 调整后毛利率约 50%，随规模增长发挥作用。

bridgeNote.en: September's acquisitions used roughly $160M of this cash, and Ondas has said it will keep buying.
bridgeNote.zh: 9月的收购已用去约 1.6 亿美元，Ondas 表示将继续收购。

extraNote.en: Cash includes restricted cash and short-term investments.
extraNote.zh: 现金包括受限现金与短期投资。
